name: wifiorisp
description: Ask Claude whether slow internet is your Wi-Fi or your ISP, and get the report to send your ISP.
long_description:
WiFi or ISP is a free menu bar app that times your router and the internet at the same moment, so it can say whether slow or dropping internet is your Wi-Fi (or router) or your ISP. This extension lets Claude read the same verdict through WiFi or ISP's `wifiorisp` command line tool.

Ask things like "is it my Wi-Fi or my ISP?", "why is my internet slow?", "is my ISP down?", or "write up the outages to send my ISP".

Requires the WiFi or ISP app (https://wifiorisp.com). Everything is local and read-only. Speed and lag tests are off unless you turn them on in this extension's settings: the speed test is run by M-Lab, which publishes every result, including your IP address, as open data.

allow_tests.title: Let Claude run speed and lag tests
allow_tests.description: Off by default. Each test takes about 20 seconds and can use a few hundred MB. The speed test is run by M-Lab, which publishes every result, including your IP address, as open data.

wifiorisp_cli.title: WiFi or ISP command line tool (optional)
wifiorisp_cli.description: Leave empty to find WiFi or ISP automatically in Applications, Homebrew, or Spotlight.

tools.name: connection_status
tools.description: Whether slow internet is your Wi-Fi or your ISP right now, and what to do next

tools.name: connection_history
tools.description: Typical timings, slow spells, drops, and outages over a period

tools.name: isp_report
tools.description: The plain-text report of outages and slowness to send your ISP

tools.name: speed_test
tools.description: Download and upload speed from M-Lab (off unless turned on in settings; publishes your IP)

tools.name: lag_test
tools.description: Lag under load and where it builds up (off unless turned on in settings)
